datasets.name: ds_vol_snapshot
queryLines:
WITH top20 AS (
  SELECT factor_name FROM __CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.gold_hist_vol
  WHERE calc_date = (SELECT MAX(calc_date) FROM __CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.gold_hist_vol) AND window = '1y'
  ORDER BY ann_vol DESC LIMIT 20
)
SELECT h.factor_name, h.window, ROUND(h.ann_vol * 100, 2) AS ann_vol_pct
FROM __CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.gold_hist_vol h
JOIN top20 t ON h.factor_name = t.factor_name
WHERE h.calc_date = (SELECT MAX(calc_date) FROM __CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.gold_hist_vol)
ORDER BY h.factor_name, h.window

datasets.name: ds_vol_ts
queryLines: SELECT calc_date, factor_name, ROUND(ann_vol * 100, 2) AS ann_vol_pct FROM __CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.gold_hist_vol WHERE window = 'ewma' AND factor_name IN ('IR_USD_DF10Y', 'FX_EUR', 'FX_JPY', 'EQ_AAPL', 'EQ_AMZN') ORDER BY calc_date

datasets.name: ds_corr_ts

Monte Carlo book PV distribution and VaR. time_step 1 is the 1-day horizon. USD.

config.source:
SELECT s.as_of_date, s.run_id, s.trade_id, s.product, s.book_id, s.desk, s.business_unit,
       s.sensitivity_type, s.risk_class, s.risk_factor, coalesce(s.tenor_label, '-') AS tenor_label, s.value_usd,
       m.counterparty_id, m.ccy, m.ccy_2, m.underlying, m.notional, m.maturity_date, m.mtm_usd,
       concat(s.business_unit, ' / ', s.desk) AS desk_path
FROM __CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.v_trade_sensitivity_latest s
LEFT JOIN __CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.v_trade_mtm_latest m
  ON m.as_of_date = s.as_of_date AND m.run_id = s.run_id AND m.trade_id = s.trade_id
WHERE s.as_of_date = coalesce(as_of_sel, (SELECT max(as_of_date) FROM __CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.v_trade_mtm_latest))
config.comment: v_trade_sensitivity_latest with trade MTM and terms from v_trade_mtm_latest (same as_of_date and run_id), for one as-of date (as_of_sel, default latest). USD cash greeks.

config.source:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT as_of_date, total_mtm_usd, n_trades
  FROM __CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.v_risk_runs
  QUALIFY run_ts = max(run_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY as_of_date)),
var AS (
  SELECT as_of_date, sum(var_95) AS var95_1d, sum(expected_shortfall_95) AS es95_1d
  FROM __CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.v_var_latest
  WHERE time_step = 1 GROUP BY as_of_date)
SELECT coalesce(r.as_of_date, v.as_of_date) AS as_of_date, r.total_mtm_usd, r.n_trades, v.var95_1d, v.es95_1d
FROM runs r FULL OUTER JOIN var v ON r.as_of_date = v.as_of_date
config.comment: Total MTM per as_of_date from v_risk_runs (latest run per date) and 1-day (time_step 1) VaR95 / ES95 summed over books from v_var_latest (undiversified).

dimensions.name: has_sensitivities
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN total_mtm_usd IS NOT NULL THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END

config.source:
SELECT i.*,
       CASE WHEN i.tenor_label IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN i.tenor_label LIKE '%M' THEN cast(left(i.tenor_label, length(i.tenor_label) - 1) AS double) / 12
            ELSE cast(left(i.tenor_label, length(i.tenor_label) - 1) AS double) END AS tenor_years
FROM __CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.v_trade_market_inputs_latest i
WHERE i.as_of_date = coalesce(as_of_sel, (SELECT max(as_of_date) FROM __CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.v_market_snapshot_latest))
config.comment: v_trade_market_inputs_latest for one as-of date (as_of_sel, default latest). Zero rates, vols, HW sigma and dividend yields are decimals (0.05 = 5%).

frame.title: EWMA Vol — Key Factors Over Time

lines: Annualised volatilities: rolling windows (3M/1Y/3Y/10Y) plus EWMA (λ=0.94).
Pearson correlation (504-day window), nearest-PSD repair. 11 core IR + FX factors.
Mean reversion α and short-rate volatility σ from DF vol ratios. Cases 1–7 per methodology.
Uncollateralised Expected Exposure (EE) and Potential Future Exposure at 95% (PFE95) across simulation time steps, as of 2026-10-22. Values in USD.
95% Value at Risk and Expected Shortfall by trading book from 1,000 Monte Carlo paths, as of 2026-10-22. Time step 1 = 1-day horizon. Values in USD.

Trade cash greeks and MTM from the daily **risk-sensitivities-daily** job, latest run per as-of date. Drill down business unit > desk > book with the filters or by clicking a bar, then pick a trade to see every sensitivity and the market inputs it was priced with. Units (USD): FX / equity delta = value change per +1% move; gamma = change in that delta per +1%; vega per +1 vol point; IR DV01 = whole curve +1bp; key rate = one curve tenor +1bp.
Desks are shown as *business unit / desk* because the same desk name exists in more than one business unit. Pick a book before browsing trades.
